# atlassian_jira_project (Data Source)

Look up a Jira project by ID or key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_jira_project" "example" {
  id = "PROJ"
}

output "project_id" {
  value = data.atlassian_jira_project.example.id
}

output "project_key" {
  value = data.atlassian_jira_project.example.key
}

output "project_name" {
  value = data.atlassian_jira_project.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Project ID or key (e.g. PROJ or 10000).

### Read-Only

- `key` (String) Project key.
- `name` (String) Project name.
